status: Fitted fleet redesigns. Rustbucket is recorded separately in its existing fitted model.
axes: Four new designs use Three.js hull-local X starboard, Y up, Z aft, as in src/05-ships.js before instance transforms. Plan point pairs are [X,Z]. Deck floor provides Y. Convert to Blender [X,-Z,Y]. Relocate first-person origin when integrating.
openings: Door spans lie on both adjacent polygon edges. OUT is an external hatch; TRUNK is a non-walkable cargo shutter. Lifts are flush walk-on platforms; endpoints are on the listed floor datums. Wall segments adjoining finished decking use the room polygon and remove the specified clear spans.
anchors: Seat positions are cushion centres in plan. Repair marks locate interaction stations in plan. Detailed socket heights and facing directions must be set during 3D blockout.
verification: Sampled 2D connectivity on a 0.16 m grid using a 0.21 m clearance radius, blocking drawn bulkhead walls, furniture and seats. All occupied rooms, lift stops, passenger approaches and seven fault types reachable from cockpit. The fitted Blender models and game decks use these coordinates. Game navigation checks use the exported collision grids. See the fleet handoff for the exterior fit sample.

ships.name: Dromedary 400
ships.concept: A family hauler with a home in its hump. Side loading keeps container traffic below the passenger majlis.
ships.materials: Levantine flatweave, indigo wool and warm copper pass from hand to hand. The riveted steel and yellow gantry belong to the freight business.

decks.name: Freight deck
decks.brief: The pilot steps into a transverse dispatch room. A sliding freight door opens onto two sled rails. The starboard side hatch loads the hold directly, and a separate crew lift rises into the hump.

decks.name: Hump deck
decks.brief: The lift opens aft into the boot lobby. Two window divans form the passenger majlis forward. The crew bunk and compact coffee galley flank the landing, so nobody sleeps beside the loading rail.

ships.name: Stellar Stoat
ships.concept: A streamlined courier organized around a quiet private wardroom and a cargo capsule with two bypasses.
ships.materials: Soft clay upholstery, ash joinery and carpeted wall returns recall the domestic warmth of a TNG captain’s quarters. Teal belts and a teardrop turbine carry the courier identity aft.

decks.name: Courier deck
decks.brief: The bubble cockpit opens into the captain’s wardroom. Two shoulder passages wrap a sealed cargo capsule and reunite at the turbine. Either route reaches the engine while the cargo doors are shut.

ships.name: Opulent Manatee
ships.concept: A liner with a port-side promenade and a lounge directly under the observation dome. Staff and baggage travel on a separate working deck.
ships.materials: Bookmatched walnut, stepped bronze, oxblood club chairs and opal glass mark the passenger spaces. Cream enamel gives way to steel grating below.

decks.name: Promenade deck
decks.brief: The forward lift opens into a reception hall. The port promenade stays beside the windows and leads directly to the dome lounge. Staff use an enclosed starboard passage and the aft lift to serve the pantry.

decks.name: Working deck
decks.brief: Freight arrives through the port baggage lock. The long starboard service passage connects both lifts to engineering, so a steward can cross the ship without threading through cases or a passenger salon.

ships.name: Quasar Empress
ships.concept: A Japanese imperial-villa sequence inside a needle hull. The forecourt frames a ceremonial view into the ship’s actual ring station. Freight travels beneath the state rooms.
ships.materials: Smoked hinoki lattice, black urushi lacquer and shell inlay lead into spare pearl-toned engineering. The exterior ring stays outside the pressure hull.

decks.name: State deck
decks.brief: An axial procession leads from the command canopy through a receiving room and moon court to the ring gallery. Two private suites open off the court. The display garden stays to port of the walking line.

decks.name: Freight undercroft
decks.brief: The ring-station lift lands in a transverse transfer room. Fore and aft vaults open independently for freight handling. The galley sends meals up the same lift to private dining via the gallery.
